messages:
Maria (AE): Quick async standup — MacroHealth pilot: legal just asked for a KMS/HSM integration checklist by EOD. Where are we on keywrap docs + on‑prem fingerprint? cc @Jordan (Eng) @Olivia (Sales Ops)

Jordan (Eng): On it. PR uploaded: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/342 — pending sec review. Need confirmation on customer network topology (VPN vs. direct peering).

Sanjay (SE): Confirmed their HSM vendor supports RSA-OAEP keywrap. One blocker: their appliance requires mTLS client cert rotation every 30 days; that affects onboarding automation. Raising SOW escalation.

Sanjay (SE): Example rotation flow I plan to share:
```bash
#!/bin/bash
# rotate client certs for HSM mTLS
openssl req -new -key client.key -out client.csr -subj "/CN=redwood-client"
# upload CSR to customer HSM admin portal (manual step)
# fetch signed cert, replace /etc/redwood/hsm-client.crt, restart agent
systemctl restart redwood-hsm-agent
```

Olivia (Sales Ops): I'll ping MacroHealth for topology diagram and confirm if they can accept our CA. Legal also asked: "do you support attestation logs from the HSM?" I linked our internal answers: https://redwood.internal/enterprise/kms-answers

Emma (Solutions): I uploaded a first-pass security FAQ for the pilot to Confluence: /MacroHealth/KMS-onboarding — includes fallback plan (cloud KMS) and customer opt-in. Note: dedicated-onprem option keeps keys in HSM but requires IP whitelisting.

Jordan (Eng): For Dedicated pilot, we can keep key material in their HSM; will need HSM IPs to be whitelisted on our side. Who's owning firewall requests? @eng-infra or should I file?

deploy-bot: build 8a9f2 passed for infra/kms-integration — staging deployed to us-west-2 :white_check_mark:

Olivia (Sales Ops): Maria — propose short call with MacroHealth security: Tue 10am PST or Wed 4pm PST. Which works?

Maria (AE): Tue 10am PST works for me. Sanjay? Jordan?

Sanjay (SE): Tue 10 works. I'll prepare a cert rotation doc and checklist to share during the call.

Jordan (Eng): I'll file the firewall rule request and assign to eng-infra (ticket INFRA-1987). Will add required IPs once customer sends topology.

Emma (Solutions): Quick product question — will relying on cloud KMS fallback change our latency SLOs for the pilot? If so, we should document expected variance and surface to the customer. cc @Product

Olivia (Sales Ops): Adding a 'KMS-gating' flag to the deal tracker and noting potential uplift for dedicated onboarding (estimate +6% TCV).

Maria (AE): Action items: Olivia confirm call time with customer; Jordan file firewall tickets and link topology ticket; Sanjay prepare cert rotation checklist; Emma update FAQ with SLO note; I will update legal pack. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
